applications.name: Retro Chess Arena
applications.tagline: Master tactics against intelligent chess bots and offline puzzles
applications.description: Retro Chess Arena is an elegant, retro-styled chess client designed for offline and casual multiplayer tactical training. Featuring configurable neural-heuristic AI opponents, custom opening explorers, and over 1,500 grandmaster puzzle scenarios. Built with clean standard graphics and low latency input for competitive chess enthusiasts.
features: Play against 8 difficulty levels of tactical AI
Over 1,500 offline tactical puzzles with solution hints
PGN file import/export and move notation logs
Full keyboard and touch-first board navigation

screenshots.title: Main Board View
screenshots.caption: Classic wooden board with dynamic legal move indicators and capture tray

screenshots.title: Tactics Trainer
screenshots.caption: Daily tactical puzzle scenarios with evaluation bar and hint mode

screenshots.title: Engine Analysis
screenshots.caption: Deep heuristic evaluation and opening book statistics

permissions.name: Storage (Read/Write)
permissions.detail: Required only for importing and exporting PGN game files

reviews.author: Magnus K.
reviews.comment: Outstanding responsive board feel. The offline puzzle mode is top notch!

reviews.author: Elena R.
reviews.comment: Crisp visuals, works flawlessly on both my Windows desktop and Android tablet.

applications.name: Aether Calculator
applications.tagline: Precision scientific calculations, graphing and unit conversions
applications.description: Aether Calculator is a modern, distraction-free scientific and programmer calculator. It supports high-precision decimal operations, real-time formula evaluation, dynamic unit conversions across 30+ physical domains, and instant memory recall. Designed with zero telemetry and instant startup time.
features: Full scientific, trigonometry, and logarithmic functions
Programmer mode with binary, octal, decimal, and hex conversions
Comprehensive unit converter for currency, weight, length, and velocity
Session calculation history with one-tap expression recall

screenshots.title: Scientific Keypad
screenshots.caption: Full scientific layout with matrix math and complex number evaluation

screenshots.title: Unit Converter
screenshots.caption: Instant live conversions across physical and digital units

screenshots.title: History Panel
screenshots.caption: Scrollable timestamped calculation archive with export

permissions.name: None
permissions.detail: Operates entirely offline without device permissions

reviews.author: David W.
reviews.comment: The cleanest calculator app I have ever used. Fast, zero ads, no bloat.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.comment: Programmer mode is an absolute lifesaver for binary/hex bit-shifting.

applications.name: Chronos Task Manager
applications.tagline: Streamline workflows with agile boards, timers, and offline privacy
applications.description: Chronos provides a lightweight, local-first productivity workspace combining visual Kanban boards, Pomodoro sprint timers, and markdown task notes. Your data stays on your local filesystem without requiring cloud sign-ins.
features: Customizable multi-column Kanban boards with drag-and-drop
Integrated Pomodoro timer with audio cues and break intervals
Markdown-enabled checklists and sub-task nesting
Local JSON backups and automated daily snapshots

screenshots.title: Kanban Workspace
screenshots.caption: Visual columns for To Do, In Progress, Review, and Done

screenshots.title: Focus Timer
screenshots.caption: Integrated 25-minute Pomodoro timer with ambient sounds

screenshots.title: Sprint Analytics
screenshots.caption: Weekly task completion metrics and productivity streaks

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.detail: Used solely to alert you when a focus timer finishes

reviews.author: Liam T.
reviews.comment: Local-first productivity is the future. Chronos is fast and reliable.

applications.name: Markdown Canvas
applications.tagline: Distraction-free technical writing and instant diagram rendering
applications.description: Markdown Canvas is a focused editor built for software engineers and documentation writers. Featuring live split-pane rendering, full Mermaid.js and KaTeX math support, code block copy shortcuts, and one-click PDF/HTML export.
features: Live dual-pane markdown rendering with synchronized scrolling
Full support for Mermaid diagrams, MathJax formulas, and tables
Customizable dark, light, and solarized code syntax themes
Zero-telemetry local file system auto-save

screenshots.title: Dual Pane Editor
screenshots.caption: Clean monospace editor alongside live rendered HTML preview

screenshots.title: Diagram Rendering
screenshots.caption: Instant visualization of flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and equations

permissions.name: File System
permissions.detail: Required to open and save local .md and .markdown documents

reviews.author: Sara M.
reviews.comment: Replaced three bloated editors with this. It renders Mermaid diagrams instantly.

applications.name: Weather Pulse
applications.tagline: Real-time atmospheric telemetry, radar maps, and accurate forecasts
applications.description: Weather Pulse delivers hyper-local meteorological forecasts using open data sources. Features hourly temperature timelines, precipitation barometers, wind vectors, UV index indicators, and animated satellite radar overlays.
features: 7-day hourly temperature, humidity, and barometric trends
Interactive Doppler radar and cloud coverage maps
Air Quality Index (AQI) telemetry and pollen warnings
Custom weather widgets with automatic low-power refreshes

screenshots.title: Daily Telemetry
screenshots.caption: Hourly forecast curves and precipitation probabilities

permissions.name: Location (Optional)
permissions.detail: Used only to determine local weather when requested

reviews.author: Carlos G.
reviews.comment: No intrusive ads, accurate radar, and beautiful clean animations.

applications.name: Pixel Pulse Audio Studio
applications.tagline: Synthesizer studio, beat sequencing, and live visualizer
applications.description: Pixel Pulse is a creative WebAudio sound studio featuring an 8-track drum sequencer, dual-oscillator polyphonic synthesizer, customizable reverb/delay effects, and real-time audio FFT spectral visualizer.
features: 8-channel drum step sequencer with tempo and swing controls
Polyphonic subtractive synthesizer with ADSR envelopes and filters
Interactive frequency spectrum analyzer and waveform display
WAV audio export and MIDI keyboard device support

screenshots.title: Step Sequencer
screenshots.caption: 8-track rhythm grid with velocity controls and sample selection

screenshots.title: Synthesizer Rack
screenshots.caption: Oscillator filters, LFO modulation, and delay/reverb bus

permissions.name: Microphone (Optional)
permissions.detail: Required only if recording live vocal samples

reviews.author: Jordan K.
reviews.comment: Remarkably powerful in-browser synth. Audio export is crystal clear.

applications.name: DevTerm Pro
applications.tagline: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator with multi-tab multiplexing
applications.description: DevTerm Pro is a modern, high-performance terminal emulator engineered for developers. Supports custom color themes, ligatures, split-pane multiplexing, SSH session bookmarks, and full UTF-8 Unicode glyph rendering.
features: GPU-accelerated rendering with low input latency
Split-pane horizontal and vertical terminal multiplexing
Built-in SSH session organizer with key agent integration
Customizable powerline themes and font ligature support

screenshots.title: Multiplexed Terminals
screenshots.caption: Quad split panes running live build scripts and system monitors

screenshots.title: Theme Configurator
screenshots.caption: Over 20 built-in dark and high-contrast color palettes

permissions.name: Network Access
permissions.detail: Required for remote SSH connections and terminal sessions

reviews.author: Alex N.
reviews.comment: The fastest terminal on Windows. Split panes work flawlessly.

applications.name: Vector Craft Paint
applications.tagline: Vector drawing and raster editing with layer masks
applications.description: Vector Craft is a versatile creative design studio combining vector spline paths with raster brush tools. Perfect for sketching UI mockups, game sprites, icons, and illustrations.
features: Bézier vector pen tool with node editing and snapping
Non-destructive layer blend modes and opacity masks
Export to SVG, PNG, WebP, and PDF with resolution scaling
Stylus pressure sensitivity and palm-rejection support

screenshots.title: Vector Canvas
screenshots.caption: Precision spline path manipulation and gradient fills

screenshots.caption: Hierarchical grouping, blend modes, and mask controls
